description: Labelled retrieval queries over the technical reference corpus in rag/corpus. Each query names the section(s) that actually answer it. Two splits: 'direct' queries use the vocabulary of the target section, and 'paraphrase' queries deliberately avoid it, asking the way an operator or an agent mid-reasoning would. The paraphrase split is where a lexical retriever is expected to struggle and where embeddings should earn their keep, so the scorecard reports the two splits separately.
labelling_note: Relevance was labelled by reading the corpus, not by running the retriever. A query is allowed more than one relevant section when more than one genuinely answers it; recall@k counts a hit if ANY relevant section is retrieved, and precision@k counts the fraction of retrieved passages that are relevant.
